timestamp.description: Add timestamps to events. 0 = none, 1 = human-readable, 2 = epoch seconds (double --timestamp)

current_mount.description: Only record events on partition/mount of current directory

output_file.description: Write events to given file instead of standard output

timeout.description: Stop after the given number of seconds. 0 = run indefinitely

user_info.description: Add process user information to events, formatted as "[uid:gid]"

ignore_pids.description: List of process IDs to ignore events for. Can be specified multiple times.

filter_types.description: List of event types to show. TYPES is a list of C, R, O, W, D, +, or < with the above meanings. < and > both mean "move" and will always enable both directions.

command_filter.description: Show only events for this command
